selected_profile.meaning: Reviewed combined applicability; never alias for each configuration number.

page_size.meaning: Page size in bytes, bound to the actual build/run.

disk_sector_size.meaning: Decoded sectorsize of the registered filesystem archive; not a deadline observation.

mount_flags.meaning: User syscall flags; cannot infer from a successful mount alone.

request_values.meaning: Requests actually present in this registered run, not arbitrary future requests.

disk_at_deadline.meaning: Applicable disk reference at consumption; absent unless separately evidenced.

adjacent_disk.meaning: Later disk sample, not interchangeable with deadline reference.
